description: This file defines the CachedTeamFeatureRepository class, which implements caching logic for team feature data, including methods for finding, updating, deleting, and checking features for teams, utilizing memoization decorators.

classes.name: CachedTeamFeatureRepository
classes.description: A repository class that manages cached access to team feature data, implementing the ITeamFeatureRepository interface with methods for CRUD operations and feature checks.

methods.name: findByTeamIdAndFeatureId
methods.description: Retrieves team feature data by team ID and feature ID, utilizing memoization for caching.

methods.name: findByTeamIdsAndFeatureIds
methods.description: Fetches multiple team features for given team IDs and feature IDs.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates or updates a team feature record, invalidating cache as needed.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a team feature record, invalidating cache.

methods.name: findAutoOptInByTeamId
methods.description: Checks if a team has auto opt-in enabled, with caching.

methods.name: findAutoOptInByTeamIds
methods.description: Retrieves auto opt-in statuses for multiple teams.

methods.name: setAutoOptIn
methods.description: Sets auto opt-in status for a team, invalidating cache.

methods.name: checkIfTeamHasFeature
methods.description: Checks if a team has a specific feature enabled.

methods.name: getEnabledFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves enabled features for a team, with caching.

methods.name: getTeamsWithFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Gets list of team IDs with a specific feature enabled.
